data_fields.name: stance_ratio_gate_edge
data_fields.donor_constant: ratioDiff >= 0 with two or more attackers (stance 3); ratioDiff + outNumber >= -1 (stance 2)

data_fields.name: unblockable_clock_formula
data_fields.donor_constant: 1 + (life - unblockable now) / unblockable next; 0 if none now

best_idea: Pick each fighter's stance from a race ratio (our life over their counter damage against their life over our unblocked damage) plus a force count, through an ordered six-stance ladder, and read the stance per fighter with a few personality numbers.
decision_why: The race-ratio ladder and the personality data fit a coach's default stance when the coach is absent and pre-fight planning; but the fixed per-blocker penalty mixes units, the next-turn unblockable clock may have swapped roles, and the profile loader throws on an unknown key, so we keep the ladder and fix those.
acceptance: A server test on a fixed board (3 of our attackers, 2 of theirs able to block, life 20 vs 15) returns the stance from the race rule and not stance 5 unless the attrition race is won; a personality file with a missing or misspelled key fails validation at load and names the key; an absent coach's fighter commits at the computed stance.
